# x402 UUID Toolkit

> Deterministic UUID generation, validation and parsing for agents. v4 (random), v7 (time-ordered), nil, max. No accounts. Pay per call with x402 (USDC on Base).

## Paid Endpoint

- POST /api/generate
  - Input: `{ "action": "generate|validate|parse", "version": "v4|v7|nil|max", "uuid": "..." }`
  - Output: `{ "success": true, "result": "...", "meta": {...} }`
  - Price: ~0.006 USDC

## Free Discovery

- GET /catalog
- GET / (service card)

## Why agents use it

- Zero variance, pure crypto/random or time-based
- Token-cheap, high frequency safe
- Perfect for ID generation, request correlation, agent state keys
